intro: Fourteen SQL injection articles published between 2026-04-14 and 2026-10-24 trace a critical-heavy severity mix of seven critical, four high, and two medium vulnerabilities. CVE-2026-27681 (CVSS 9.9) leads the coverage, followed by CVE-2026-36962 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-42208 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-6433 (CVSS 9.8), and CVE-2026-34259 (CVSS 9.6). Enterprise software, web hosting, e-commerce, government, and retail rank among the most affected sectors, while Europe, Global, North America, and United States appear as the top affected regions across the archive.
